criteria.requirement: Add explicit wrapt.weak_cache.weak_method_cache(maxsize=128,typed=False) using real wrapt descriptor/decorator binding and WeakFunctionProxy. Maintain id+weakref-verified per-instance caches without requiring instance hash/equality or __dict__; weak callbacks remove exact matching entry, bound methods must not strongly retain instance. Expose cache_count() and cache_clear(instance=None). Reject nonweakrefable/class/plain usage clearly, preserve method results/exceptions and functools argument/typed semantics. Thread-safe cache creation, no singleflight promise. Cached result or arguments that themselves retain self follow normal retention and are excluded from weak-lifetime guarantee. Existing lru_cache unchanged.
